name: Animated Sparse Voxel Octrees (ASVO)
aliases: Animated Sparse Voxel Octree Renderer with X-Toon Shading
definition: ASVO is an animation technique for sparse voxel octrees that allows applying rigid transformations or skinning to voxel-based 3D models.
summary: ASVO is a GPU-based raycasting method that renders animated sparse voxel octrees by dynamically updating spatial acceleration structures every frame to handle bone-driven deformation.
